# Don't Repeat Yourself

> An AI agent skill for saving verified coding solutions as searchable recipes and adapting them to future projects.

Maintainer: kevin-12-ou
Repository: https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/dont-repeat-yourself
License: MIT
Skill name: dont-repeat-yourself
Version: 1.0.0
Install: npx skills add kevin-12-ou/dont-repeat-yourself --skill dont-repeat-yourself
